anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Your seed shall be a sojourner.
The seed would be a sojourner in a land not theirs.

pass_a_gloss: Those then having listened to the prophet will complete this, being sojourners to him, having come to be according to his tyranny in a time of famine, as having taken from their fathers the most ancient oath-swearing that their seed would be a sojourner as toward father Abraham.
pass_b_english: Those then who have listened to the prophet will complete this, being sojourners to him, having come to be under his tyranny in a time of famine, as having received from their fathers the most ancient oath-promise that their seed would be a sojourner — as toward father Abraham (Genesis 15:13) (Genesis 12:10) (Acts 7:6).
source_text: Οἱ οὖν τοῦ προφήτου κατακούσαντες τελέσουσιν τοῦτο πάροικοι αὐτῷ ὄντες, κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ τυραννίδα γενόμενοι ἐν χρόνῳ λιμοῦ, ὡς ἀπὸ πατέρων αὐτῶν τὴν παλαιοτ<άτ>ην ὅρκωμοσίαν εἰληφότες ὅτι πάροικον ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ὡς πρὸς π(ατέ)ρα Ἀβραάμ.
